reason: A Feishu/Lark integration plugin that exposes a local DSH agent through bot conversations, with streaming cards, interactive approvals, proactive messages, attachments, and per-chat sessions.

summaries.zh: 通过飞书机器人远程使用本机 DSH 智能体，支持流式卡片、交互问答与审批、主动推送、附件处理和多会话管理。
summaries.en: Use a local DSH agent through a Feishu bot with streaming cards, interactive questions and approvals, proactive messages, attachment handling, and separate chat sessions.

capabilities: Connects to Feishu/Lark through a WebSocket long connection
Receives chat messages and forwards them to a local DSH agent
Streams agent progress and tool-call status through Feishu cards
Provides interactive question and tool-approval buttons
Sends proactive text or card messages to Feishu chats
Downloads image, file, video, and audio attachments
Maintains separate sessions per Feishu chat and restores context across restarts
